snapshot_note: Point-in-time inventory; refresh after repository or workspace_support archive changes and before explicit staging.

policy.tracked_changes: always stage with git add -u when --stage is used

source_coverage.coverage_rule: Every non-ignored untracked path with a source suffix is listed as selected or with an explicit exclusion reason. git ls-files --exclude-standard deliberately omits ignored paths; they are never force-added.
